Nonprofit Tech Network: code of conduct

We connect volunteers and staff who work on technology for charities.

  1. Advertising of any kind is prohibited.
  2. Please disclose any use of AI in your post.
  3. Members may share relevant links to tools and guides.

Questions about these rules can go to the organisers.
